ex.en: The new store will officially open next Monday.
ex.zh: 新店將於下週一正式開幕。

ex.en: The company has not officially announced the merger yet.
ex.zh: 公司尚未正式宣布合併。

ex.en: Higher prices offset the drop in sales.
ex.zh: 價格上漲抵銷了銷量的下滑。

ex.en: We plant trees to offset our carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 我們種樹來抵銷碳排放。

ex.en: Taiwan is building offshore wind farms.
ex.zh: 台灣正在興建離岸風場。

ex.en: He kept his money in an offshore account.
ex.zh: 他把錢存在境外帳戶。

ex.en: Many companies moved production offshore.
ex.zh: 許多公司把生產線移到海外。

ex.en: The ship was anchored offshore.
ex.zh: 那艘船停泊在離岸處。

ex.en: The speaker's comments were highly offensive.
ex.zh: 那位講者的言論非常冒犯人。

ex.en: I found his joke rather offensive.
ex.zh: 我覺得他的笑話很冒犯人。

ex.en: The team needs a stronger offensive strategy.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍需要更強的進攻策略。

ex.en: He is the team's best offensive player.
ex.zh: 他是隊上最好的進攻球員。

offensive.zh: 攻勢（charm offensive 魅力攻勢）

ex.en: The company launched a marketing offensive.
ex.zh: 公司發動了一波行銷攻勢。

ex.en: The new CEO began a charm offensive to win back customers.
ex.zh: 新任執行長展開魅力攻勢，想贏回顧客。

ex.en: Turn off the lights before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前把燈關掉。

ex.en: The TV is off.
ex.zh: 電視是關著的。

ex.en: I'm off tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天休假。

ex.en: Tom took the day off.
ex.zh: 湯姆今天請假。

ex.en: Everything is 20% off today.
ex.zh: 今天全面八折。

ex.en: You can get 10% off with this coupon.
ex.zh: 用這張優惠券可以打九折。

ex.en: I'm off to work now.
ex.zh: 我要去上班了。

ex.en: The bus drove off before I got there.
ex.zh: 我還沒到，公車就開走了。

ex.en: The picnic was called off because of the rain.
ex.zh: 野餐因為下雨取消了。

ex.en: The baseball game was called off due to rain.
ex.zh: 棒球比賽因雨取消了。

ex.en: He often sits by me and listens to music.
ex.zh: 他常坐在我旁邊聽音樂。

ex.en: He often walks with his hand in his pocket.
ex.zh: 他走路時常把一隻手插在口袋裡。

ex.en: You've been late for school more often than before.
ex.zh: 你上學遲到的次數比以前多了。

ex.en: How often do you have to see the dentist?
ex.zh: 你多久要看一次牙醫？

ex.en: How often do you wash your car a month?
ex.zh: 你一個月洗幾次車？

ex.en: We have a door between our offices.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室之間有一扇門。

ex.en: I went home and Bill stayed at the office.
ex.zh: 我回家了，比爾留在辦公室。

ex.en: Hundreds of people were waiting outside the ticket office.
ex.zh: 售票處外面有數百人在等候。

ex.en: Where is the nearest post office?
ex.zh: 最近的郵局在哪裡？

ex.en: The mayor has been in office for two years.
ex.zh: 市長已經上任兩年了。

ex.en: She took office in January.
ex.zh: 她在一月就任。

ex.en: There were ten police officers on the spot.
ex.zh: 現場有十名警員。

ex.en: How did you become a police officer?
ex.zh: 你是怎麼成為一名警察的？

ex.en: There's a police officer at the door.
ex.zh: 門口有位警察。

ex.en: I was searched by the customs officers at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場被海關人員搜查。

ex.en: She is the company's chief financial officer.
ex.zh: 她是公司的財務長。

ex.en: That is a criminal offense, and you will surely be punished!
ex.zh: 那是刑事犯罪，你一定會受到懲罰！

ex.en: Driving without a license is a serious offense.
ex.zh: 無照駕駛是嚴重的違法行為。

ex.en: No offense, but I don't agree with you.
ex.zh: 無意冒犯，但我不同意你的看法。

ex.en: I didn't mean to cause any offense.
ex.zh: 我無意冒犯任何人。

ex.en: Our team needs a stronger offense.
ex.zh: 我們隊需要更強的進攻。

ex.en: Their offense scored three times in the first half.
ex.zh: 他們的進攻在上半場得了三分。

ex.en: Parents want the best for their offspring.
ex.zh: 父母都希望給孩子最好的。

ex.en: The bird feeds its offspring insects.
ex.zh: 這種鳥用昆蟲餵養幼鳥。

ex.en: The atomic bomb is the offspring of 20th century physics.
ex.zh: 原子彈是二十世紀物理學的產物。

ex.en: The new company is the offspring of a merger.
ex.zh: 這家新公司是合併後的產物。

ex.en: Federal, state, and community officials immediately pledged to rebuild it.
ex.zh: 聯邦、州和地方官員立刻承諾會重建。

ex.en: The number of officials doubled last year.
ex.zh: 去年官員人數增加了一倍。

ex.en: Thai is the official language of Thailand.
ex.zh: 泰文是泰國的官方語言。

ex.en: James Cameron personally did the official promotion!
ex.zh: 詹姆斯．卡麥隆親自官宣！

ex.en: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
ex.zh: 你接受他的提議真是太傻了。

ex.en: I had no choice but to accept the offer.
ex.zh: 我別無選擇，只能接受這個提議。

ex.en: She received a job offer from a bank.
ex.zh: 她收到一家銀行的錄取通知。

ex.en: He offered his seat to an old woman.
ex.zh: 他把座位讓給一位老太太。

ex.en: The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
ex.zh: 這個神話讓我們得以了解古代文明。
